candidates.name: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
support_spans: an irregular, firm, erythematous, mobile, tender mass
nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli within a collagenous stroma
candidates.why: The clinical presentation and histological features are consistent with dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, a rare skin tumor.

candidates.name: Bednar tumor
support_spans: strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45
candidates.why: The immunohistochemical staining pattern is suggestive of a Bednar tumor, a rare variant of dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.

candidates.name: Plexiform fibrohistiocytic tumor
support_spans: lobulated, tan-gray, firm mass partly covered by skin
mitotic figures, including atypical forms, measured 7–8 per 10 high-power fields
candidates.why: The gross and microscopic features, including the presence of mitotic figures, are consistent with a plexiform fibrohistiocytic tumor.

candidates.name: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
support_spans: an irregular, firm, erythematous, mobile, tender mass
the dermal tumor extended into the superficial subcutis and was composed of nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells
candidates.why: The clinical presentation and histological features are consistent with dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.

candidates.name: Malignant melanoma
support_spans: strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45
contradict_spans: There was no intracytoplasmic melanin pigment, and the overlying epidermis showed no increase in basal melanocytes, junctional activity, or pagetoid spread
candidates.why: The immunohistochemical staining results suggest a possible melanocytic origin, but the absence of melanin pigment and other features argue against malignant melanoma.

candidates.name: Leiomyosarcoma
support_spans: nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli
candidates.why: The histological features, including the presence of spindle-shaped cells and prominent nucleoli, could be consistent with leiomyosarcoma.

unexplained_specific_evidence: There was no intracytoplasmic melanin pigment, and the overlying epidermis showed no increase in basal melanocytes, junctional activity, or pagetoid spread

selector.rationale: The presence of an irregular, firm, erythematous, mobile, tender mass and nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli within a collagenous stroma support the diagnosis of Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.
